responsibility: Implements the REAL parsing and format-analysis core used by higher-level real string and channel I/O modules. It owns the finite-state scanner for signed fixed and scientific notation, classifies strings into ConvTypes results, converts validated input with dtoa.strtod, raises a module-specific EXCEPTIONS source for invalid or out-of-range values, and computes formatted output lengths by rendering through ConvStringReal and measuring the resulting DynamicStrings.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file implements RealConv’s parsing and conversion machinery, including the scanner state procedures, FormatReal/ValueReal behavior, exception raising, and length calculations via rendered strings. RealConv.def only publishes those conversion and query entry points and their types.
